version: as published in the NRC-Mila/OBELiX GitHub repository (main branch, retrieved 2026-09-12); paper arXiv:2502.14234
role: experimental_conductivity (DATA_CONTRACT.md dataset role D: final regression target)
paper_reference: Therrien et al., "OBELiX: A Curated Dataset of Crystal Structures and Experimentally Measured Ionic Conductivities for Lithium Solid-State Electrolytes", Digital Discovery, 2026, 5, 910-918.
paper_doi_note: Published version (RSC Digital Discovery, vol. 5, issue 2, pp. 910-918, published online 2026-01-22); same work as preprint arXiv:2502.14234 and ScienceDirect record S2635098X26000203. 10.1039/D5DD00441A is the primary-source DOI used for provenance verification.

files.notes: Extracts to all_randomized_cifs/<ID>.cif, 321 files. Coordinates carry upstream-applied randomization noise (symmetry-preserving); original CIFs are private (see data_README.md).

record_unit: one synthesized solid electrolyte material with an experimentally measured room-temperature ionic conductivity
available_identifiers: Laskowski ID, Liion ID (secondary-database cross-references, sparsely populated)
DOI (source publication per row; 223 unique DOIs across 599 rows)
available_structure_fields: Reduced Composition, True Composition, Z (formula units)
Space group, Space group #, lattice parameters a/b/c/alpha/beta/gamma
target_field_unit_note: raw column is S/cm at reported measurement temperature; DATA_CONTRACT.md's canonical target y = log10(sigma_RT / S cm^-1) must be derived explicitly in Phase 1, not assumed pre-transformed.

temperature_scope_verification.verified_claim: The primary-source abstract (Therrien et al., Digital Discovery, 2026, 5, 910-918) states the dataset comprises 'experimentally measured room temperature ionic conductivities gathered from literature and curated by domain experts.' This confirms dataset-level curation scope is room-temperature ionic conductivity.
temperature_scope_verification.row_level_caveat: Dataset-level curation intent is verified as room temperature; the redistributed CSVs (all.csv/train.csv/test.csv) carry no explicit per-row temperature column, so individual-row measurement temperature cannot be independently confirmed from the local files alone. Treat 'Ionic conductivity (S cm-1)' as room-temperature by curation policy, not as a per-row-verified field.
temperature_scope_verification.method: Resolved DOI 10.1039/D5DD00441A via doi.org redirect to the RSC Digital Discovery article landing page (pubs.rsc.org/dd/article/5/2/910-918/312885, Issue 2 2026) and cross-checked against the arXiv:2502.14234 abstract, which carries matching room-temperature language; RSC article page itself returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the abstract text was confirmed via the arXiv preprint of the same work plus indexed search-result excerpts of the RSC abstract.

target_dtype: object (free text: exact values and inequality-censored values are mixed in the same column)

censoring.policy_reference: DATA_CONTRACT.md 'Censoring': primary analysis must use a censor-aware strategy or exclude these points with a documented sensitivity analysis -- not yet decided in this phase.

total_vs_bulk_conductivity.note: The primary 'Ionic conductivity (S cm-1)' column does not itself carry a per-row total/bulk label for most rows; 'IC (Total)' and 'IC (Bulk)' are sparse auxiliary columns. DATA_CONTRACT.md prohibits silently mixing total and bulk conductivity -- this must be resolved with an explicit, versioned, tested harmonization rule in Phase 1, not inferred here.

family_distribution.note: top 10 of the 'Family' column value counts; usable as a structural-family OOD holdout axis per EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md

disorder.method: pymatgen Structure.is_ordered on each locally available CIF

official_split.provided_by: dataset authors, as train.csv (478 rows) and test.csv (121 rows)
official_split.usage: use as the primary split per EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md ('Primary split must preserve the official benchmark split when feasible'); do not re-split without a documented reason.

duplicates: 0 duplicate ID rows. 85/599 rows (14.2%) share a Reduced Composition with at least one other row (distinct polymorphs/measurements/publications of the same composition, not row-level duplication) -- see reports/results/leakage/within_dataset_duplicates.json for structure-level duplicate detection on the 321 available CIFs.
known_missing_censored_disordered_data: 9/599 rows have no 'Cif ID' reference at all; 590/599 have a Cif ID reference but only 321/599 (53.6%) have a CIF file redistributed in this repository -- the remaining referenced structures are withheld upstream (ICSD/COD licensing). 37/599 rows are inequality-censored. Space group is populated for all 599 rows even without a CIF.
notes: This is the final task dataset; per RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md and EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md, its test split and labels must never be used for tuning, model/seed/split selection, or pretraining-stage decisions. Cross-dataset overlap against the three pretraining datasets is reported in reports/results/leakage/obelix_vs_pretraining_structure_overlap.json.
